name: Derive Hopper pipeline stage count from tile storage
summary: Choose or validate the Hopper mainloop stage count from operand types, CTA tile shape, shared-memory alignment, and a stage-count policy.

strategy.intent: Construct a legal and performance-relevant GEMM tile mapping for the target architecture.
strategy.mechanism: Compute bytes per A/B tile, account for aligned pipeline storage, and either apply an explicit override or maximize stages within the carveout.
strategy.expected_benefit: Exposes data reuse and parallel Tensor Core work while respecting layout and resource limits.
tradeoffs: Tile choices change shared-memory use, register pressure, occupancy, and available grid parallelism.
